title: The constrained Lojasiewicz-Simon inequality on the unit sphere of a Hilbert space
author: Zdzisław Brzeźniak, Javed Hussain
work: Dynamical properties of constrained heat flow on Hilbert manifolds
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations, Vol. 2026 (2026), No. 13, pp. 1--13; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.13; published February 11, 2026; publisher version
difficulty_reason: Even with the analytic-gradient-flow background, the source-local Simon theorem and the elliptic regularity of the Dirichlet Laplacian available as context, the counted theorem is not quoted: the author has to derive the Lojasiewicz-Simon inequality on the constraint manifold itself. The proof has to produce an explicit real-analytic chart from the normalisation map Psi together with its analytic inverse Xi, move the constrained functional to the Hilbert space of the tangent plane, identify the reduced gradient through the adjoint A(h) of the chart differential and prove the two-sided norm equivalence between the reduced gradient and the projected H-gradient, verify that the linearisation is the restriction of the second variation and has compact resolvent, invoke the classical Lojasiewicz-Simon theorem in the chart, and only then transfer the chart estimate back to a V-neighbourhood of the stationary point. Deriving a manifold-constrained gradient inequality of this kind is research level, not a qualification exercise.
